limitations: Existing encryption.json and eventbridge.json were read for request/receipt patterns; neither contains an embedded probe source in the current revision.
No inference of a cold KMS request is made from elapsed time. Fresh unique topic contexts isolate grants; captured KMS management events establish observed KMS calls.
Queue absence is bounded and never classified as denial without an actual correlated target DLQ outcome.
Only same-account custom-bus EventBridge service-principal publication is measured. No execution role, caller STS credential, or IAM/Organizations policy is created or changed.

findings.summary: In this native same-account custom-bus EventBridge -> encrypted standard SNS -> raw SQS run, aws:SourceArn, aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceOrgID were present in KMS service authorization. The exact rule ARN, exact account 000000000000, and exact organization o-dnfz62bval individually allowed delivery; the exact topic ARN and all three Null=true conditions produced correlated target DLQ KMSAccessDenied failures.

documentation_boundary.quoted_contract: Adding the aws:SourceAccount, aws:SourceArn, and aws:SourceOrgID to a AWS KMS policy is not supported for EventBridge-to-encrypted topics.
documentation_boundary.comparison: The observed successful exact-value KMS grants and failed Null=true grants contradict an interpretation that these keys are always absent in this path. This experiment does not change or establish the AWS support guarantee stated by the documentation.

findings.authority_separation: All SNS topic policies independently allowed events.amazonaws.com Publish only with the exact source rule ARN AND source account. Each service KMS grant was scoped to a different fresh topic encryption context. Only its additional KMS source condition varied; the unconditional control omitted only source conditions, not topic-context isolation. Negative target errors explicitly identify kms:GenerateDataKey/KMSAccessDenied, not SNS topic-policy denial. No key policy was changed after creation.
findings.kms_context_evidence: Successful GenerateDataKey and Decrypt CloudTrail request parameters include aws:sns:sourceArn (the exact rule), aws:sns:sourceAccount (000000000000), and aws:sns:topicArn. These encryption-context names are distinct from IAM global aws:Source* condition keys. Presence/value of the global keys is established by policy outcomes, not inferred by equating those names. Organization ID is established by successful exact-value authorization plus Null=true rejection; it is not present in captured encryptionContext.

import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('testdata/aws/sns/encryption_service_sources.json')
s=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert s.get('finished_ms') and not s.get('failure'), s.get('failure')
findings=[]
for case,topic in s['owned_resources']['topics'].items():
    receipts=[r for r in s['receipts'] if r['case']==case and r['correlated']]
    assert len(receipts)==1,(case,len(receipts))
    r=receipts[0]; attrs=r['decoded_message_attributes']
    expected=s['events'][r['round']][case]['event_id']
    assert expected==r['decoded_event']['id']
    matching=[]; request_id=None
    if r['queue']=='dlq':
        match=re.search(r'Service: AWSKMS;.*?Request ID: ([a-f0-9-]+)',attrs['ERROR_MESSAGE'])
        assert match, attrs
        request_id=match[1]
    for x in s['cloudtrail']['events']:
        e=x['event']
        if e['eventName'] not in ['GenerateDataKey','Decrypt']: continue
        context=(e.get('requestParameters') or {}).get('encryptionContext',{})
        if (request_id and e.get('requestID')==request_id) or (not request_id and context.get('aws:sns:topicArn')==topic): matching.append(e['eventID'])
    findings.append({'case':case,'kms_source_condition':s['case_conditions'][case],'topic_arn':topic,'rule_arn':s['owned_resources']['rules'][case]['arn'],'original_event_id':expected,'sqs_message_id':r['message']['MessageId'],'receipt_observed_ms':r['observed_ms'],'outcome':'actual_collector_receipt' if r['queue']=='collector' else 'actual_target_dlq_failure','dlq_error_code':attrs.get('ERROR_CODE'),'kms_request_id_from_dlq':request_id,'correlated_kms_cloudtrail_event_ids':matching,'correlation_basis':'Exact KMS request ID from actual target DLQ ERROR_MESSAGE' if request_id else 'Only publication to this fresh topic in captured run; same exact topic encryption context in KMS audit events. CloudTrail does not contain the original EventBridge event ID.'})
assert {f['case'] for f in findings if f['outcome']=='actual_collector_receipt'}=={'unconditional','source-rule','source-account','source-org'}
assert {f['case'] for f in findings if f['outcome']=='actual_target_dlq_failure'}=={'source-topic','null-arn','null-account','null-org'}
verifications=[o for o in s['cleanup'] if o['label'].startswith('verify-')]
for o in verifications:
    if o['label']=='verify-key-pending-deletion': assert o['result']['output']['KeyMetadata']['KeyState']=='PendingDeletion'
    else: assert o['result']['code'] in ['NotFound','ResourceNotFoundException','AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue'],o
assert len(verifications)==28,len(verifications)
s['findings']={'summary':'In this native same-account custom-bus EventBridge -> encrypted standard SNS -> raw SQS run, aws:SourceArn, aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceOrgID were present in KMS service authorization. The exact rule ARN, exact account 000000000000, and exact organization o-dnfz62bval individually allowed delivery; the exact topic ARN and all three Null=true conditions produced correlated target DLQ KMSAccessDenied failures.', 'documentation_boundary':{'url':'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-key-management.html','retrieved_on':'2026-09-23','quoted_contract':'Adding the aws:SourceAccount, aws:SourceArn, and aws:SourceOrgID to a AWS KMS policy is not supported for EventBridge-to-encrypted topics.','comparison':'The observed successful exact-value KMS grants and failed Null=true grants contradict an interpretation that these keys are always absent in this path. This experiment does not change or establish the AWS support guarantee stated by the documentation.'},'authority_separation':'All SNS topic policies independently allowed events.amazonaws.com Publish only with the exact source rule ARN AND source account. Each service KMS grant was scoped to a different fresh topic encryption context. Only its additional KMS source condition varied; the unconditional control omitted only source conditions, not topic-context isolation. Negative target errors explicitly identify kms:GenerateDataKey/KMSAccessDenied, not SNS topic-policy denial. No key policy was changed after creation.', 'kms_context_evidence':'Successful GenerateDataKey and Decrypt CloudTrail request parameters include aws:sns:sourceArn (the exact rule), aws:sns:sourceAccount (000000000000), and aws:sns:topicArn. These encryption-context names are distinct from IAM global aws:Source* condition keys. Presence/value of the global keys is established by policy outcomes, not inferred by equating those names. Organization ID is established by successful exact-value authorization plus Null=true rejection; it is not present in captured encryptionContext.', 'cases':findings,'unresolved_cases':[f['case']+' lacks a matching KMS CloudTrail event in the bounded history poll; target outcome remains established by the actual correlated receipt.' for f in findings if not f['correlated_kms_cloudtrail_event_ids']], 'limits':['No cross-account, other-region, default-bus, role-target, or other event-source behavior is established.','One original event per isolated topic; no retry repair or recovery message was necessary or claimed.','The exact target failures establish rejection; no elapsed no-receipt window is used as evidence of denial.','The audit lookup retains only owned-key events and page counts/times/tokens for otherwise unrelated account history. Lookup end time is fixed near delivery completion; polling does not extend event time scope.']}
s['cleanup_summary']={'independently_verified_absent':{'custom_event_bus':1,'rules':8,'subscriptions':8,'topics':8,'sqs_queues':2},'verification_observation_labels':[o['label'] for o in verifications], 'key':next(o['result']['output']['KeyMetadata'] for o in verifications if o['label']=='verify-key-pending-deletion'),'standing_resources_modified':False,'created_iam_resources':False}
s['analysis_source']={'filename':Path(__file__).name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'content':Path(__file__).read_text()}
p.write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'outcomes':[(f['case'],f['outcome'],f['correlated_kms_cloudtrail_event_ids']) for f in findings],'unresolved':s['findings']['unresolved_cases'],'key':s['cleanup_summary']['key']['KeyId'],'deletion_date':s['cleanup_summary']['key']['DeletionDate'],'independent_verifications':len(verifications)},indent=2))
